The sealed PLAN arm's realized rate on the whole roster was 5,425 contacts over 1,080 rows (5.023 per row), which on these 119 rows would be about 598 contacts (cell CONV realized 4.13 per row on an intent-error roster); every row here is an intent-error row and so likelier than average to spend its revision budget, which is why the ceiling and not the average is registered. At the sealed arm's own 3.6819 GPU hours per 5,425 contacts the whole ceiling costs about 0.89 GPU hours; the rank labels add a short prefix per rendered value of the two named stores and no contact. The budget is RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id, which is what makes the resume-recovery clause safe.
